hooks.command: echo 'RESEARCH PROTOCOL: save findings to OpenBrain (openbrain.store) with tag research before completing task'

hooks.prompt: Check if this session involved code changes. If yes, verify: 1) Were tests mentioned or run? If code was changed but no tests were run, respond with {"decision": "block", "reason": "Run tests before finishing — code was changed but tests were not verified."}. 2) If this was a pipeline task, was OpenBrain tagged appropriately? If not, respond with {"decision": "block", "reason": "Tag OpenBrain with the appropriate status before finishing."}. If everything looks good or this wasn't a code task, respond with {"decision": "allow"}.
